context: Checks scope boundaries for the skill and the step-by-step path for metrics and Logs Insights.

checklist.name: S3 task is out of scope
checklist.description: Says S3 does not use the microConsole iframe so the iframe patterns are not needed

checklist.name: S3 uses normal clicks
checklist.description: Says locator.click() works normally for S3

checklist.name: Link task needs no browser
checklist.description: States no browser is opened for the URL-only request

checklist.name: Metrics task is in scope
checklist.description: Treats the CloudWatch metric graph as a console task for this skill

checklist.name: Metrics path starts at CloudWatch Metrics
checklist.description: Route goes CloudWatch, Metrics, All metrics

checklist.name: Selects namespace then dimension
checklist.description: Selects the namespace and filters by dimension

checklist.name: Uses Graph metrics
checklist.description: Clicks Graph metrics to plot the selection

checklist.name: Adjusts time range in toolbar
checklist.description: Sets the time range in the graph toolbar

checklist.name: Mentions Logs Insights route if relevant
checklist.description: Where Logs Insights is mentioned, route is Services, CloudWatch, Logs, Logs Insights

checklist.name: Mentions absolute time range and Run query
checklist.description: Where Logs Insights is mentioned, sets an Absolute time range and clicks Run query
